query: Someone hit my parked car, damaged it, and drove away without leaving their contact details. I don’t know who the driver was. Can I file a police complaint, and what action can be taken against them?
I witnessed someone being attacked, but the police told me they wouldn’t register a complaint because I’m not the victim. Is that correct?
My cousin was taken to a police station for questioning, and the officers aren’t telling us whether he’s been arrested. What rights does he have?
My brother was arrested yesterday, but the police haven’t allowed our family to contact him. What can we do?
I reported a serious crime, but the police haven’t taken any action for several weeks. Is there a way to escalate my complaint?
Someone borrowed my laptop for a week and has now stopped answering my calls or returning it. What can I do?
A shopkeeper accused me of stealing and forced me to stay inside his shop until I paid him. Is he allowed to do that?
A stranger photographed my sister without her permission and is threatening to post the pictures online. What can we do?
I paid someone in advance to repair my phone, but they disappeared with both my phone and money. Is this a police matter?
Someone created a fake social media account using my name and is messaging people pretending to be me. Is this illegal?
A group of people surrounded my car and wouldn’t let me leave until I apologised to them. Can I report this?
A person deliberately pushed me down the stairs during an argument, and I fractured my arm. What can I do?
Someone sold me a second-hand motorcycle and later I discovered that the registration documents were fake. What law applies?
My neighbour’s dog attacked me, and the owner knew it was aggressive but never restrained it. Can I file a complaint?
A person is demanding money from me and threatening to reveal an embarrassing secret if I refuse. Is that a crime?
My roommate secretly took money from my wallet while I was sleeping. Can I report it even though we live together?
A security guard searched my bag and physically prevented me from leaving a building without explaining why. Is that legal?
Someone deliberately set fire to a pile of materials stored outside my house, and the flames damaged my property. What offence is this?
A person convinced my elderly grandfather to sign papers he couldn’t understand and transferred his property. Can we challenge this?
I accidentally transferred money to the wrong person, and they are refusing to return it. Can I file a criminal complaint?
A person is repeatedly coming to my workplace and threatening my colleagues because of a personal disagreement. Can I seek protection?
